4. Defendant 1-3 contested the suit by filing a written statement. Their case is that the land of the entire suit khatian being 47 was sold in auction in Rent Execution case 1495 of 1945. It was purchased by the original Zamindars and after keeping it in their possession for more than 2 years. The disputed land was settled to the defendants in 1358 B.S. and 1360 B.S. by the Zaminders on the basis of pattas. Defendants since then are in possession. Defendants denied the story of dispossession of the plaintiffs by them. 

 7. After the S.A. record was prepared in the name of the defendants the plaintiffs filed Misc. Case under section 19A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for correction of the record claiming them-selves as the owners of the suit land and in possession of the suit land. The case was heard and disposed of on 1.9.1968. The judgment is Ext. 3 wherein the Assistant settlement officer (ASC) held that the plaintiffs were in continuous possession of the disputed plot till 1968. Of course, that judgment was reversed by the appellate authority vide its judgment dated 2.2.1969.
